verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents official SDKs: a first-party JavaScript SDK for tracking events and sending them to destinations, on-demand plugins, and a claim of 16 SDKs that let you instrument once and send standardized data to hundreds of destinations. This covers the story's core of building against official SDKs. missing for 10: per-SDK documentation for languages beyond JavaScript, independent or hands-on corroboration of the SDKs' developer experience, and any AI-native-specific SDK guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: RudderStack's JavaScript SDK lets you track customer event data from your website and send it to your specified destinations.
Load specific SDK features on demand using plugins.
Instrument one RudderStack SDK and automatically send standardized data to hundreds of destinations
With over 200 pre-built integrations, including 16 SDKs, you can connect new data sources to your entire stack in a matter of minutes.
